entities.name: Information Element Repetition Handling
entities.description: Procedure for handling repeated information elements in messages when repetition is not specified, when repetition is specified, and when repetition limit is exceeded.

entities.name: Unspecified IE Repetition
entities.description: Condition where an information element is repeated in a message but repetition is not specified in clause 8.

entities.name: Specified IE Repetition
entities.description: Condition where repetition of information elements is explicitly specified.

entities.name: IE Repetition Limit Exceeded
entities.description: Condition where the limit on repetition of information elements is exceeded.

entities.name: Handle First IE, Ignore Subsequent
entities.description: Behavior where UE handles only the first occurrence of a repeated IE and ignores all subsequent repetitions.

entities.name: Handle Specified Repeated IEs
entities.description: Behavior where UE handles only the contents of specified repeated information elements.

entities.name: Handle IEs Up to Repetition Limit
entities.description: Behavior where UE handles IEs appearing first up to the repetition limit and ignores subsequent repetitions.

relations.description: Procedure applies when IE repetition is not specified.
Procedure applies when IE repetition is specified.
Procedure applies when IE repetition limit is exceeded.
Unspecified repetition condition establishes the behavior to handle first IE and ignore rest.
Specified repetition condition establishes the behavior to handle only specified repeated IEs.
Repetition limit exceeded condition establishes the behavior to handle IEs up to limit and ignore rest.
